returns.alphaStakingBal: Staked ALPHA tokens valued at NAV + staking reward pool
returns.wbtcBal: Treasury WBTC balance valued in USD
returns.wethBal: Treasury WETH balance valued in USD

params.sharesAmount: The amount of native shares/tokens to redeem.

returns.assetsReceived: The net amount of USDC/EURC stablecoins received.

auditProofOfReserves().notice: Writes an on-chain audit record (emits ProofOfReservesAudited event). Restricted to owner.         For polling/reading use getProofOfReserves() instead.

deposit(uint256).notice: Allows users to deposit stablecoins to mint native shares (0.5% entry fee split: 50% Treasury Reserves, 25% Ops, 25% Corporate Revenue).

getAssetBalance(address).notice: Returns the amount of specific asset held by the Treasury (including yield vaults).

getAssetBreakdown().notice: Returns a per-asset USD breakdown for the Proof of Reserves dashboard.         Values are in 18-decimal USD.

getAssetValue(address,address,uint8).notice: Helper to calculate the USD value of an asset in 18 decimals using Chainlink.

getNAV().notice: Returns the Net Asset Value (NAV) of the Treasury in USD with 18 decimal places.

getProofOfReserves().notice: View-only Proof of Reserves calculation (no event emitted, safe for polling).

rebalance().notice: Rebalances portfolio weights on-chain. Restricted to owner.

redeem(uint256).notice: Allows an investor to redeem shares directly for stablecoins based on the NAV.

releaseVaultPayout(address,uint256).notice: Allows VestedDiscountVault to request reimbursement payouts upon ragequit/maturity.

setOracleStalenessLimit(uint256).notice: Updates the oracle price feed staleness check limit. Restricted to owner.

setTrackedAsset(address,address,uint8).notice: Adds or updates an asset tracking config.

setTvlCap(uint256).notice: Updates the TVL cap for the Treasury.

validateSanityBounds().notice: Validates that the current portfolio weights are within the sanity bounds.
